title: Registering as a new customer
text: To become a customer, open the Register page and fill in every field: first name, last name, address, city, state, zip code, phone number, SSN, a username and a password (the password is typed twice). When the form is accepted you are logged in straight away and your first account is created for you.

title: Your first account
text: A new customer starts with one account, with a balance of $515.50. The Accounts Overview page lists every account with its balance and available amount, and a total at the bottom. The balance includes deposits that may be subject to holds.

title: Opening another account
text: Open New Account lets you choose CHECKING or SAVINGS. A minimum of $100.00 must be deposited into the new account when it is opened. You choose an existing account to transfer the funds from.

title: Transferring funds between your accounts
text: Transfer Funds moves money from one of your accounts to another. Enter the amount, choose the account to take it from and the account to put it in, and submit. A successful transfer shows the heading 'Transfer Complete!' with the amount and both account numbers.

title: Paying a bill
text: Bill Pay asks for the payee's name, address, city, state, zip code and phone number, the payee's account number (entered twice; the two must match), the amount, and the account to pay from. Every field is required. A successful payment shows a confirmation with the payee, the amount and the account it came from, and the amount is taken from that account.

title: Finding transactions
text: Find Transactions searches one account. You can search by transaction ID, by a single date, by a date range (dates are typed as MM-DD-YYYY), or by amount.

title: Updating your contact information
text: Update Contact Info lets you change your first name, last name, address, city, state, zip code and phone number. Your username and password are not changed there.

title: Requesting a loan
text: Request Loan asks for a loan amount, a down payment and the account the down payment is taken from.

title: Logging out
text: The Log Out link in the left-hand menu ends your session and returns you to the login page.
